summary.tldr: Requires prison sentences for sexual offences to be served one after another, not at the same time, in certain cases.
what_it_does: Replaces subsection 718.3(7) of the Criminal Code with a rule on how sexual offence sentences are served.
Requires a prison sentence for a sexual offence to be served after any other sexual offence sentence imposed at the same time.
Requires a prison sentence for a sexual offence to be served after any other sexual offence sentence the person is already serving when sentenced.
summary.background: It replaces subsection 718.3(7) of the Criminal Code.
